clues.it: Dario era nella 6ª colonna e accanto a una sedia.
clues.en: Dario was in the 6th column and beside a chair.

clues.it: Carla era accanto a una sedia e in Cambusa.
clues.en: Carla was beside a chair and in the Galley.

clues.it: Anna era l'unica seduta su una sedia.
clues.en: Anna was the only one sitting on a chair.

clues.it: Olga era l'unica persona su una pozza.
clues.en: Olga was the only person on a puddle.

clues.it: Tea era nella 11ª colonna e sul Ponte.
clues.en: Tea was in the 11th column and on the Deck.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Vito era in una stanza diversa da Tea.
clues.en: Vito was in a different room from Tea.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 8ª colonna e nella 9ª riga.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 8th column and in the 9th row.

clues.it: Irene era nella 10ª riga e accanto a una pianta.
clues.en: Irene was in the 10th row and beside a plant.

clues.it: Marta era nella 2ª colonna e nella 11ª riga.
clues.en: Marta was in the 2nd column and in the 11th row.

steps.it: L'indizio di Dario lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Dario's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 6th.

steps.it: Solo Carla può stare nella 2ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 5ª è sua.
steps.en: Carla is the only one who can be in the 2nd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 5th is theirs.
